# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance, Skia m151, and WASM .NET 11** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the engine to Skia m151 and delivers a wave of managed-code performance improvements. Hot paths across HarfBuzzSharp, SKShaper, SKColor, and SKPMColor move allocation-heavy work into managed code, reducing P/Invoke round-trips and eliminating short-lived array allocations. WASM support is extended to .NET 11 via Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The engine is now built from Skia chrome/m151, bringing upstream rendering fixes and improvements from Google's Chromium-aligned release. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))
- **Multiple upstream chrome/m151 stability syncs** — Three additional upstream syncs from the chrome/m151 branch apply engine-level stability and correctness improvements throughout the release cycle. ([#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimised with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — Parsing hex colour strings is now allocation-free on the fast path, and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads let callers avoid string allocations entirely. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions** — GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe context, making it easier to use in projects that do not enable unsafe code. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native handle was not released when decoding a cropped region from an SKData source failed, leading to a silent memory leak. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **WASM SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition warning fixed** — A duplicate preprocessor definition in the Skia submodule produced compiler warnings in WASM builds; the upstream redefinition is now dropped. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKColor, SKColorF, SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code** — Color conversion hot paths (SKColor↔SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply) now run entirely in managed C#, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on paths called per-pixel in rendering loops. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzzSharp and SKShaper allocation-free paths** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free, per-call char[4] allocations in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.ToString and SKFourByteTag.Parse are eliminated, and SKShaper glyph result reads use zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Platform

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM** — New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries ship with SkiaSharp, enabling WASM builds targeting .NET 11 preview. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8(string), elimination of per-call char[4] allocations in Tag parsing, and Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11.
